// PROBE: a customer-facing notification list reading every channel with no
// grouping — the exact shape P1-04 fixed. The scanner must flag this.
export async function getHistory(db: any, userId: string) {
    return db.notificationEvent.findMany({
        where: { userId, channel: { not: "analytics" } },
        orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
        take: 50,
    })
}
